scope: Linear description/comment table structure editing and mobile submit access

tests.scope: 77 focused table/seed-ID/native/frontend tests, 17 golden fidelity tests and 6 SDK contracts
tests.environment_note: Initial SDK setup could not bind a local port in the sandbox. All six SDK tests passed with local-server permission.

verified: Insert rows above/below and columns left/right, delete rows/columns, move rows/columns, and align columns without losing rich cell content.
Tab and Shift+Tab move between cells; Tab in the last cell adds a row and focuses its first cell.
Structural edits and table deletion support native Chrome undo/redo.
Row/Column/Alignment menus support arrow keys, Escape, and Shift+F10 from a cell; focus leaving the editor hides the table controls.
Native description and comment Markdown retains column order/alignment, bold text and surrounding paragraphs. Protected issue is unchanged.
Mobile alignment menu fits x=153.05..333.05 and y=443.89..563.89; document width equals 390px.
Compact menus visually inspected; no screenshot files retained. Footer spacing keeps Comment clear of the floating Controls toggle; pointer submission was verified.
Short landscape Row menu fits x=266..446 and y=213.89..365.89; Tab closes the Row menu and focuses Column options.
After replaying an explicit comment ID, a pointer-submitted mobile comment keeps the existing table comment intact and receives a distinct ID.

native_readback.note: Description/table-comment readback precedes a local restart for the footer/focus fix; pointer comment submission was checked afterward.

remaining: Column resize/drag handles, table multi-selection and authenticated provider visual comparison remain open.
Mentions, uploads, full workspace/collaboration/settings/admin/billing/analytics/AI scope and complete responsive/reference inventory remain open.

seed_id_followup.problem: A generated ID could overwrite a record restored with an explicit seed ID.
seed_id_followup.fix: Reserve all explicit seed IDs before seeding and skip already allocated or live dictionary IDs during deterministic UUID allocation.
